preconditions.description: K must be between 1 and the length of S inclusive.
All characters in S must be lowercase letters.

postconditions.description: The return value must be a string.
All characters in the return value must be lowercase letters.
The length of the return value must be equal to the length of S.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(S[i:] + S[:i] for i in range(len(S))) if K == 1 else ''.join(sorted(S))
postconditions.description: If K is 1, the return value must be the lexicographically smallest string obtained by rotating S. If K is greater than 1, the return value must be the lexicographically smallest string obtained by sorting the characters of S.
